items.title: IEEE Region 8 Student Branch Chapter of the Year — 2026
items.text: Awarded the prestigious Region 8 Student Branch Chapter of the Year 2026 distinction, recognising the IEEE Circuits and Systems Society ENET'Com SBC as a top-performing student chapter across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. This milestone celebrates a year of sustained dedication, cohesive teamwork, and measurable technical impact—driven by hands-on hardware workshops, collaborative engineering initiatives, and active student mentorship at ENET'Com.

items.title: IEEE Region 8 Student Branch Chapter of the Year — 2024
items.text: Honored as the Region 8 Student Branch Chapter of the Year 2024, marking a defining achievement in the chapter's history at ENET'Com. Selected among student chapters across IEEE Region 8, this award recognises the chapter's strong organisational leadership, consistent student engagement, and commitment to advancing education and innovation in circuits and systems.

items.title: 3rd Place — TSYP 13 Tunisia CASS Chapter Challenge
items.text: Secured 3rd Place in the Tunisia CASS Chapter Challenge during the 13th Tunisian Students and Young Professionals Congress (TSYP 13). Competing against engineering student branches nationwide, our team demonstrated strong technical execution, collaborative problem-solving, and practical circuit and system design skills on a national stage.
